final_validation.user_instruction: After the full x1 run, check against the original repository and investigate/fix/repeat if numbers differ significantly, within the existing launch cutoff and absolute-stop limits.

final_validation.recipe_check: utils/eval/recipe.py, graders.py and benchmarks.py are unchanged against upstream/main. FP16 is allowed on T4. The original official full evaluation uses 8 samples; our x1 is full question coverage, not an official full-x8 submission.
final_validation.artifact_check: Run cloud/verify_eval.py on downloaded full-x1 results/records using the frozen local questions; require exactly 2759 IDs and one answer each, correct seeds/caps/recipe, completed grading, matching summaries.
final_validation.verification_command: .venv-local/bin/python cloud/verify_eval.py --out runs/kaggle-vllm-v7/runs/full-x1 --development-reference runs/kaggle-vllm-v6/400-log-summary.json (adjust v7 directory only if an authorized replacement version is launched)
final_validation.diagnostic_flags: The matched-slice verifier flags accuracy changes greater than 10 percentage points or mean token length changes greater than 30%. These are investigation thresholds, not rigorous paired significance tests: v6 per-answer artifacts are unavailable. Exit code 2 requires investigation before completion; exit 1 is an artifact/recipe audit failure.
final_validation.score_check: Compare benchmark scores and mean token lengths with the v6 400 log summary; also extract the SAME 100-per-benchmark question slice from the full records to avoid confusing cohort composition with a backend failure. Investigate substantial changes in accuracy, token length, truncation or unreadable output; batching and FP16 can cause stochastic differences, so do not label every difference a bug.
final_validation.retry_rule: Fix proven evaluation faults and regrade saved records without regenerating whenever possible. Retry generation only when needed and authorized time remains. Do not claim a numeric match to an upstream baseline that is not published.
